nodeGroups.name: Collect
nodeGroups.description: Fetches Google Trends interest over ~60 days for 5 keywords across US + India using just 2 SerpApi multi-query requests per run.

nodeGroups.name: Score & Store
nodeGroups.description: Transposes each multi-query response per keyword, computes average interest and momentum, then upserts 10 rows into workflow_popularity.
